description: Regression proof for implementation task 5 (simulation event weights/pileup/genEventSumw aggregation, Part A; branch-accessibility probe retry, Part B): FileParser._parse_opened_file run on real files, once with feature/cms-object-fields-and-bool-cuts (3cedb583c62465b12dfaaf8ea95ddbee30ae9bab) and once with feature/cms-mc-weights-and-probe-retry, the new keys absent (default) in both. Also confirms config.yaml (the ATLAS default) parses to an identical ParsingConfig aside from the two new fields, which default to False. Same 4 CMS files and 1 ATLAS file as implementation tasks 1-4's own regression proofs, at most 2,000 events per file.

config_level_comparison.method: PipelineConfig.from_dict(yaml.safe_load(open('config.yaml'))).parsing_config, compared field by field via dataclasses.asdict, once with the base checkout's PipelineConfig class and once with the branch's
config_level_comparison.result: IDENTICAL for every field that existed before this branch; the two new fields, read_event_weights and read_pileup_info, are both False on the branch (well-defined defaults, absent from config.yaml)

transient_network_failures_during_this_c: The ATLAS file (mc20_13TeV DAOD_PHYSLITE, rucio storage) failed transiently on the feature branch's first attempt during this session's check (a generic ak.zip 'could not find backend for ()' error from a dropped/empty read), succeeding on the second retry -- consistent with ordinary remote-storage flakiness seen throughout this project, unrelated to this task's code changes; the base branch's dump of the identical file succeeded on its first attempt.
overall_verdict: IDENTICAL for all 4 CMS datasets, one real ATLAS file, and the ATLAS default config.yaml's parsed configuration.
